info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fixed Asset Register Management API
info.description: The Fixed Asset Register Management API provides businesses with a comprehensive solution for updating and managing their fixed asset records. This API allows users to modify details related to their fixed assets, ensuring up-to-date information for effective financial and operational reporting. Typical consumers of this API include finance teams, asset managers, and IT administrators responsible for maintaining accurate asset records. Utilize this endpoint to streamline asset data management within your enterprise systems.

put.description: This operation allows you to update the details of the fixed asset register, ensuring your asset information is current and accurate. Use this endpoint to modify existing records as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the fixed asset register. It requires a JSON object that includes all necessary fields to modify an existing record in the register.
